A little about me

A creative mind with an organized approach.

I'm Design Modrigo, a multi-skilled professional who combines creative execution with operational support. I enjoy helping businesses stay consistent in their branding while keeping communication, records, schedules, and workflows moving smoothly.

My work spans branded image preparation, visual content, video editing support, documentation, coordination, CRM updates, and day-to-day administration. I bring care, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset to every task.

Skills & Tools

Creative thinking, backed by follow-through.

I like making ideas clear, content consistent, and the work behind the scenes easier to manage. I bring a mix of creative support and hands-on admin experience, so the ideas don’t stop at planning — they’re organized, tracked, and followed through.

What I do

From the first content idea to the final follow-up, I keep the details organized and the goal in focus.

Content & social: Content strategy, 30-day content calendars, branded graphics, Reel scripts and captions, short-form video editing, brand voice consistency, hashtag research, content organization, and competitor research.

Admin & coordination: CRM and lead tracking, weekly updates and reports, email and calendar support, documentation, data entry, task coordination, and follow-ups.

What I use

I use the tools I’ve worked with to create content, collaborate with teams, and keep operations moving.

Creative & AI: Canva, ChatGPT, Claude AI.

Admin & collaboration: Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams.

Construction & operations: AccuLynx, JobNimbus, ProLine, MarketSharp, QuickBooks Online.

Before focusing on social media and creative support, I built over eight years of experience across remote and BPO roles.

My background includes customer service, sales, appointment setting, content moderation, and administrative coordination.

These experiences shaped how I work today: with clear communication, accurate records, consistent standards, and a focus on following every task through to completion.
